meta.title: A. Long Documents
meta.hypothesis: SA-CMS multi-level memory retains semantic grounding as document length scales beyond standard context window limits.
meta.independent_variable: Document token length (500 vs 2000 vs 5000 tokens)
meta.dependent_variable: Evidence retrieval accuracy and refusal gate stability
meta.expected_interpretation: BM25 retrieval latency scales sub-linearly while memory state dimension remains strictly constant (O(1) memory footprint).

meta.title: B. Multiple Documents
meta.hypothesis: Cross-document queries require balanced multi-document passage selection to prevent single-document domination.
meta.independent_variable: Number of active documents (1 vs 3 vs 5 documents)
meta.dependent_variable: Cross-document citation diversity and coverage ratio
meta.expected_interpretation: Hybrid pipeline correctly pulls evidence across document boundaries rather than collapsing to the most frequent term match.

meta.title: C. Irrelevant Documents
meta.hypothesis: Injecting unrelated distractor documents does not degrade answer accuracy or induce false citations.
meta.independent_variable: Distractor document ratio (0% vs 50% vs 80% distractors)
meta.dependent_variable: Citation precision and false answer rate
meta.metric: Citation precision (fraction of cited passages that are truly relevant)
meta.expected_interpretation: Score threshold tau=3.0 successfully filters out distractor passages.

meta.title: D. Partial Evidence
meta.hypothesis: When only partial evidence is present, the system identifies partial support rather than hallucinating complete answers.
meta.independent_variable: Evidence completeness (complete premise vs partial premise)
meta.metric: Query coverage score and grounding tag
meta.expected_interpretation: Query coverage falls below 1.0, triggering partial support classification.

meta.title: E. Conflicting Evidence
meta.hypothesis: When passages contain contradictory facts, the system surfaces both citations rather than arbitrarily choosing one.
meta.independent_variable: Presence of conflicting factual assertions in separate sections
meta.dependent_variable: Multi-passage citation presence and caveat flagging
meta.expected_interpretation: Both contradictory sources are cited with respective provenance.

meta.title: F. Missing Evidence (Out-of-Domain)
meta.hypothesis: Queries completely unaddressed by ingested documents trigger 100% refusal without hallucinating.
meta.independent_variable: Query domain (in-corpus vs out-of-corpus general world knowledge)
meta.expected_interpretation: System refuses 100% of out-of-domain queries with verified refusal text.

CONDITION_F_MISSING_EVIDENCE.refusal_message: Tài liệu được cung cấp không chứa thông tin liên quan đến câu hỏi này.

meta.title: G. Paraphrased Questions
meta.hypothesis: Lexical variations, colloquial phrasing, and pronominal references are successfully resolved by the router and retriever.
meta.independent_variable: Phrasing style (exact keyword match vs semantic paraphrase vs pronoun follow-up)
meta.dependent_variable: Evidence retrieval score and answer consistency
meta.metric: Mean evidence score and retrieval rank
meta.expected_interpretation: Context resolution recovers entity references, preserving retrieval scores within 15% of verbatim queries.

meta.title: H. Noisy Retrieval Candidates
meta.hypothesis: When lexical search retrieves marginal candidates (BM25 scores near tau), refusal controller correctly rejects them.
meta.independent_variable: Synthetic noise attenuation on candidate scores
meta.expected_interpretation: Any score below tau=3.0 triggers refusal, proving calibration safety.
